connector.name: Agy Bridge
connector.registryDescription: Delegate heavy tasks from Claude Code to the Antigravity CLI (Gemini) with quota-aware failover.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package agy-bridge. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sshahzaiib account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: AGY_PATH
env.description: Path to the agy binary (defaults to `agy` on PATH)

env.name: AGY_TIMEOUT
env.description: Override the per-tool timeouts, in seconds

env.name: AGY_MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS
env.description: Truncation cap for tool output, in characters (default 50000)

env.name: AGY_DEFAULT_MODEL
env.description: Fallback model when no chain entry is available

env.name: AGY_ON_FAILURE
env.description: Set to `strict` to instruct the calling agent not to absorb failed delegations (default `fallback`)
